title: Where the ledger is read from
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0134 no longer matches the current design.
decision: The ledger is cratylus's append-only record, read where cratylus keeps it, in the project.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
